In New York, Bryce & Ren sit down with the billionaire investor to get his take on whether AI is a bubble, why he sold Alphabet and bought back into Netflix, and his plan to turn Howard Hughes into a modern-day Berkshire Hathaway. Plus, a surprising story about Warren Buffett, and Bill gives his verdict on Bryce & Ren’s own portfolios.   Video Bill Ackman on building the next Berkshire, AI & his next 10-bagger Equity Mates Investing Podcast 1h 11m Bill Ackman turned a two-person investment club into Pershing Square, a $33 billion investment giant built on high-conviction bets and some of Wall Street’s most famous battles. In New York, Bryce & Ren sit down with the billionaire investor to get his take on whether AI is a bubble, why he sold Alphabet and bought back into Netflix, and his plan to turn Howard Hughes into a modern-day Berkshire Hathaway. Plus, a surprising story about Warren Buffett, and Bill gives his verdict on Bryce & Ren’s own portfolios.
